name: Tushonka Territories
teaser: Adds territory warfare to the land of Tushonka where factions fight each other for control over each map.
description:
Overview

Tushonka Territories adds faction warfare and a dynamically changing world map. PMC relations remain unchanged and may continue infighting. But now Raiders, Rogues and Scavs will vie for control over Tushonka and can even ally with the player as they attempt to cover the map in their team colors.

List Of Features

  • Factions
  • Simulated battles
  • Reputation system
  • Player can affect the outcome
  • Full customization

Detailed Overview

FACTIONS

Scavs (dark green), Rogues (light green) and Raiders (orange) are the default factions included with this mod but they can be swapped out in the config. From the outset, each faction will attack the player on sight with a few exceptions; Rogues will not attack United States Evil Corporation characters and Scavs will not attack player Scavs. Factions will not attack their own members.

Factions will also bring their side’s boss into the raid with them for added support. Tagilla and Killa for the Scavs, Kolontay for Raiders and the Goons for Rogues.

With this mod installed you will see Scavs, Rogues and Raiders spawning on maps they normally wouldn’t. Should not cause issues with spawn mods like ABPS other than overriding the spawn settings of those three specific bot types and their bosses. Once dead, they will not respawn.

SIMULATED BATTLES

After the player exfiltrates from a raid, calculations are run on the backend to decide the outcome of the faction battle that took place. A hidden value called “faction strength” determines the final winner of each battle. Put simply, each bot killed costs that faction some of their strength. Each boss killed costs them even more. A territory may require more than one battle to flip it’s control to a different faction.

By default, the mod will simulate several battles after each raid. But this can be changed in the config to simulate battles (X) amount of minutes. This timed setting only functions while the game is running.

REPUTATION SYSTEM

It’s possible to get on friendly terms with a faction to the point where they will not attack you and may even come to your aid if you are attacked. But getting there will be difficult. Avoid killing their members while only attacking their enemies. You’ll have to choose your fights carefully as it may take several raids to get on their good side. Best to just avoid running into your preferred faction whenever possible until you’re certain that you’re not on their shit list anymore.

Additionally, disabled by default, the mod has support for overriding the standing with traders by using the associated faction’s reputation instead. Currently, the mod only connects the Scavs to Fence but more can come and it allows 3rd party extensions to connect it to traders of their choosing.

PLAYER AFFECTED OUTCOMES

Each bot that dies in raid affects the outcome of the battle. Bosses weaken a faction the most so target them whenever possible if you wish to truly take out the faction. Help your preferred faction conquer the entire map!

Right now conquering the map will only make raids easier but check the PROJECT GOALS tab for planned features!

Incompatible/Recommended Mods

Recommended
SAIN (once its released)
Any mod to make bots move around

Compatible
APBS MoreBots *and its dependent mods.

Issues
Vagabond - The location select menu shows only one faction. This issue is cosmetic, internally the factions are still there.

Incompatible
ABPS - Causes too many PMCs to spawn by default which takes away bot slots from this mod’s spawns. Separate Hostility - This mod makes its own hostilities which includes marking PMCs as enemies by default.

Installation & Quick Start
  1. Download the latest TushonkaTerritories zip
  2. Extract the SPT and BepInEx folder from it into your SPT folder (the one with the folders SPT_Runtime and BepinEx in it)
  3. Start the server
  4. Edit the config, comments and guides in the included example
  5. Restart the server
  6. Run a few raids so the factions start fighting
  7. Have fun
Configuration

To configure Tushonka Territories, enter the Config folder in the server (SPT_Runtime/user/mods) install and if you ran the server there is a file called config.jsonc. A file comes included with the mod, configExample.jsonc which includes comments for what each value does.

The mod is also now editable through the SIC (accessible through the launcher). This will allow you to have a more visual editing of the config, although there are no descriptions still.
Note: A lot of config options require an restart to properly change, if you decide to update the config through the SIC page, keep this in mind.

Modding

You can mod the data of the mod by adding data_override.json to the Data folder. The mod will load this json file instead and won’t be overridden by updates.

This allows you to completely change the factions, which bots belong to which factions, and the default state of the map. The only exception is the none faction which must be present at all times but any of its details are free to be changed.

Modding the data file comes with zero safeguards so mod carefully and ask questions if needed in my #mods-development thread.

The mod also comes with quest/achievement conditions and rewards for external mods.
If you use the “reputation” condition with the target set to the faction’s data key and the value to the desired reputation, it will create a condition that will unlock after reaching the desired reputation with that faction.
The “reputation” reward is available which will add “value” reputation to the “target” faction. This ignores reputation locks.
The “factionUnlock” reward is also available which will unlock the reputation gaining for the “target” faction.

I tried to make the mods data easily editable but there might be some things such as location names which had to be unfortunately hard coded. I will write in anything if needed to the official mod to support other modders.

Known Issues
  • The new spawn system might be a bit laggy. Adjust the config values as needed.
Project Goals
  • A companion mod that includes more bots and factions to make the map more interesting.
  • Translations for more languages.
Special Thanks

Anyone who uses and talks to me about the mod - Seeing people enjoying my mods will never cease to make me happy.

Languages:

And and extra special thanks to:
Mcdewgle - For writing a better description for the mod.

Without all of you, this wouldn’t be possible
